lessons.reason: Owned parameter states, actual losses, local products, storage/version roles and two new requests teach concrete calculus and backpropagation. Full 217-line delivered narration / 1106-line source, all 27 authored sheets plus brand, thirteen registered natives and 84 unique exact MP4 frames personally inspected. All 169 actual-helper/math checks pass. One bounded completed-result timing group remains, with sixteen multi-second channels and seven one/two-frame threshold refinements. Initial questions are neutral and all eventual values are correct. Longer settled storage/precision references retain craft deductions.

blockers.detail: GRAD-ENC-01: Twenty-three selected completed-result channels appear before their full measured clauses. Material examples include prediction 5.2 and loss .04 at 269.466667 before 273.969167 / 278.719167; initial four-row loss 43.375 at 630.233333 before 650.845833; queue mean -14.75 and next weights [1.08,.4425] at 659.633333 before 668.496833 / 681.721833; both offset losses at 707.333333 before 718.040833 / 724.015833; saved-output rejection at 959.966667 before 971.3625; successful derivative .314981 at 977.233333 before the repair clause completes 984.457; clone gradient six at 1023.566667 before the reuse clause completes 1040.675; and the new linear-request prediction/gradient at 1283.2 / 1288.433333 before 1285.703667 / 1289.728667. Seven newer channels have only one or two early decoded frames because gradientDone accepts progress >= .99; they are included as precise boundary refinements, not as claims of a long fresh-question leak. Both fresh initial questions remain neutral. First-observed timestamps are scoped search observations, not claims of globally earliest appearance.
